title: Android GridLayout wrap-content child
purpose: Check that GridLayout remeasures a wrap-content button and moves the next column when the label changes.
changes: Grid track sizing and child placement use the current measured width of wrap-content children.
steps: Find Short and Next under Wrap-content grid columns. They should appear side by side with a small gap.
Tap Change grid label. Short becomes Longer label and grows; Next should move with the column and keep its gap. Tap again to restore Short.
Turn on Right-to-left layout and repeat. The order should mirror without overlapping. Choose OK if it works, or Reject with the failing step, what you saw and your device.
expected: The first column resizes with the button label and the second column stays adjacent in both layout directions.
limits: This covers supported Bhoo grid constraints and text measurement. Full Android GridLayout, text and theme parity remain unverified.

references.scope: Grid child measurement and track placement.

validation: Seven Rust grid tests passed, including dynamic child width, sibling placement and RTL.
Full libbhoo Rust test suite passed.
A 320 × 500 browser test verified changing width, column gap and RTL placement.
